name: wk1-mary-firma
style: soft watercolor storybook illustration, loose expressive brushstrokes, warm golden and terracotta palette with deep teal shadows, textured watercolor paper, gentle light, emotional and humane, no text

beats.prompt: a woman sitting alone in a doctor's waiting room, hands folded tightly, muted watercolor blues and greys
a doctor across a desk holding an x-ray up to the light, serious expression, the woman watching his face
beats.motion: the doctor slowly lowers the x-ray, light shifts across his face

beats.prompt: close-up of a woman's hand hovering over a document with a pen, trembling slightly, warm lamplight
the woman standing at a window looking out at rain, quiet, a single warm orange light in the far distance
the same woman on a stage in warm spotlight, telling her story to an audience, radiant and strong, watercolor light blooming around her
beats.motion: the spotlight brightens, she raises a hand as she speaks, audience silhouettes lean in
